messages:
maria: Heads-up: Customer ACME reported alerts firing every ~5m but dashboard shows zeros in the same intervals. https://redwood.support/attachments/12345.png They also report billing spikes and a few 502s. @ken can you triage?

ken: On it. Which alert? can you drop the rule name and a screenshot of the alert eval?

maria: It's `api_error_rate_high`. Rule is `sum(errors)/sum(requests)` over 1m window, threshold 0.05. Console shows `agg_window: 5m` for that metric on the customer's org page. Repro steps coming.

sam: deploy-bot log shows a rollup config change deployed at 1918740000 (2026-03-15 22:00 UTC) — default `rollup_interval` changed 1m -> 5m for high-card metrics. cc @dave

dave: That would explain it. Alerts still evaluate on 1m windows; rollup ingestion writes 5m-aligned buckets so the 1m series is sparse and zeros between the 5m spikes.

alex: Quick repro I ran in Console -> Query Editor:
```
SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', ts) as t, sum(errors)
FROM metrics
WHERE name='api.errors'
GROUP BY t
ORDER BY t DESC
LIMIT 12;
```
then switch to `time_bucket('5 minute', ...)` — the 1m result shows mostly null/0 beyond recent raw retention.

maria: Customer sees alerts firing at 00:05, 00:10 etc while chart shows a single spike covering 00:00-00:05. They're calling it noisy and asking about billing impact.

ken: Plan: 1) confirm ingestion & rollup worker logs 2) reproduce via prod queries 3) mitigate: align alert window to rollup interval or set `use_raw=true` in alert config 4) postmortem + customer note.

dave: Rollup worker snippet: `rollup: metric=api.errors interval=5m wrote t=2026-03-16T00:00Z count=123` — rollups look healthy.

deploy-bot: Deployed config change 1918740000 by infra-release (change: rollup.default_interval -> 5m)

sam: I can spin a canary to revert the default for the support namespace, but that increases storage. Do we want immediate revert or just a targeted fix?

alex: Short-term fix for customers: edit alert expression to use `aggregate_window: 5m` or set `sampling=rollup`. Alternatively set `raw=true` to evaluate against unrolled/raw samples until we resolve.

maria: I'll escalate to CS and ask for ETA on a fix and whether they want a billing credit. @ken please send suggested alert patch.

ken: Sent instructions to customer with sample alert snippet (include `aggregate_window: 5m` and example PromQL). Also included steps to toggle `raw=true`.

dave: Action items: sam to run revert-canary for support ns, eng-runtime to add a Console warning when alert window != rollup interval, PM to update docs about rollup/alert alignment.

sam: Started revert canary: `kubectl -n support rollout apply -f rollup-config-canary.yaml` — monitoring CPU + storage.

maria: :thumbsup: Updating customer thread. Will open incident if they request credits.

alex: Helpful detection query to find other mismatches:
```
SELECT rule_id, alert_window, rollup_interval
FROM alerts JOIN metrics_meta ON alerts.metric_id = metrics_meta.metric_id
WHERE alert_window != rollup_interval
LIMIT 50;
```

ken: OK will follow up when canary completes. Thanks all :raised_hands:
